selected_adr_reviews.verdict: Page recovery is guarded and scoped. First-duplicate retention remains a malformed-input choice, not derived from dictionary order; the file-only recovery test is not a generic parser test.
Confined decoder and extended-template behavior are tied to bounded source and reference witnesses. The fixed-document harness supplements, but does not replace, explicit JBIG2 assertions.
Deferred runtime faults and their reporting remain source-supported. The reader's 1000-stack cap exceeds the ISO minimum 100; larger stacks are not required.
Inconsistent-image error is tested with a valid exact-xref RGB control and malformed Decode lengths. Mask references are broad, while direct assertions link the image consistency claim.

Keep integrity, authenticity, anchored trust, and revocation acceptance distinct. Signed positive and negative fixtures support the verdict gate; absent revocation remains NotChecked and requires explicit weaker acceptance.
